instruction.text: Write the word that you hear.
Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: The friends can agree to keep each other’s secrets.
atoms.b: The friends ((can)) agree to keep each other’s secrets.

atoms.a: The cap is made out of metal.
atoms.b: The ((cap)) is made out of metal.

atoms.a: The bear cub looks at its mother.
atoms.b: The bear ((cub)) looks at its mother.

atoms.a: The cup is full of hot water.
atoms.b: The ((cup)) is full of hot water.
